summary: Regression testing completed for public lessons, auth sessions, admin login, reset flow, quiz replay, responsive UI, and PWA assets.

critical.issue: Submitting a repeated operation_id can still return 500 with FastAPI ObjectId serialization error; a subsequent retry returns 200, so the required first/repeat JSON-safe deterministic response is not met.

integration_issues.issue: The live quiz request hit the backend 500 and no quiz result was rendered. Error selector exists in code but authenticated error visibility should be retested after backend fix.

action_items: Fix duplicate quiz handling so every first and repeated operation_id response excludes MongoDB _id and returns the same JSON payload; rerun backend and authenticated UI quiz tests.
critical_code_review_comments: The broad duplicate insert exception path still permits an ObjectId-containing Mongo document to reach FastAPI serialization in some replay scenarios; use an explicit duplicate-key path and normalize/projection the returned attempt.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary uniquely named learner accounts for registration and forgot-password testing; no seeded data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login, HttpOnly session behavior, refresh rotation, logout, public lessons/detail, progress, reset/change-password, mobile layout, manifest, and service-worker controller passed. Existing backend regression has 1 pass and 1 fail due quiz replay serialization.
rca of the issue: Replay requests reach the duplicate-attempt exception path. The live backend logs show FastAPI jsonable_encoder failing on bson ObjectId; the returned existing attempt is not consistently normalized before response.
